tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv')
inst = u[u.instance_id=='i-a272bb8eabd6'].iloc[0]
cur = c[c.instance_type==inst.instance_type].iloc[0]
req_vcpu = cur.vcpu * inst.p95_cpu_pct/100 / 0.7
req_mem = cur.memory_gib * inst.p95_mem_pct/100 / 0.8
print(cur, req_vcpu, req_mem)
fam = c[(c.family==cur.family) & (c.vcpu>=req_vcpu) & (c.memory_gib>=req_mem)]
print(fam.sort_values('hourly_usd'))
